purpose: Test whether keeping the Qwen GDN custom op inside the compiled/captured region removes material per-layer dispatch gaps at the qualified TP2 c64 endpoint without corrupting persistent recurrent state.

protected_control.relationship: immutable promoted comparison; R24 cannot replace it without a separately preregistered two-fresh-server confirmation and complete c1-c64 ladder

evidence_basis.prior_boundary: VLLM_USE_BREAKABLE_CUDAGRAPH was invalid because it disabled torch.compile; the compile-on explicit-splitting experiment remained untested.
evidence_basis.allocation_triage: A same-image representative-shape microbenchmark found fp8_gemm_out allocation/reuse only approximately 0-6% faster per GEMM and effectively neutral for the largest production shape, so it does not advance ahead of GDN capture.

single_variable.control: default PIECEWISE splitting list includes vllm::qwen_gdn_attention_core, vllm::qwen_gdn_attention_core_fused_norm_packed, and vllm::gdn_attention_core_xpu
single_variable.candidate: an explicit otherwise-default splitting list omits only those three Qwen/XPU GDN core ops
single_variable.unchanged: image, source, kernel, model, TP2 profile, direct P2P policy, request suite, oracle, output qualifier, and capture size 1

server_profile.retained_splitting_families: attention, mamba, short-conv, generic linear-attention, OLMo GDN, sparse attention, DeepSeek V4 attention, and HPC RoPE

measurement.excluded_warmup: one identical c64 group after server health and before measurement; this also exercises recurrent-state reuse before the measured group
measurement.required_activation_gate: effective engine config retains attention splitting, omits all three Qwen/XPU GDN split ops, both ranks log direct P2P activation, and the official block-scaled FP8 kernel is selected
measurement.required_output_gate: 64 complete 128-token responses, zero cached prompt tokens, complete raw token IDs, and no cross-base frozen-oracle collision
measurement.required_cleanup: container removed, no non-wrapper model process, and benchmark port closed

decision.promising_definition: at least 5% above the protected 774.394144 c64 median with every activation, output, recurrent-state reuse, and cleanup gate passed
decision.if_promising: preregister a wholly fresh two-server confirmation, recover the complete c1-c64 ladder, and add a longer sequential state-reuse quality gate before changing a package or public result
decision.if_below_promising: preserve as a negative or neutral diagnostic; do not promote or alter the protected result
